data.summary:
* Refactored firestoreCodeTaskRepository.ts from 1,397 → 284 lines by extracting `task-serializer.ts`, `task-dedup.ts`, `task-query-builder.ts`, and a shared `task-constants.ts` under `apps/code-agent/src/infra/firestore/`.
  * Preserved `CodeTaskRepository` interface (all 30 method signatures) and transaction semantics — 4-layer dedup runs inside the same `firestore.runTransaction` boundary as `transaction.set`.
  * Added 60 new unit tests (24 serializer + 26 dedup + 10 query-builder) including concurrent-same-key dedup and direct tests for every `select*` helper; all 162 existing repository tests preserved unchanged.
  * Second review iteration removed two unjustified v8 ignores, broke cross-module coupling via `task-constants.ts`, dedupe'd DocLike / PR-window scan helpers, and widened execution-memory input types to accept `Date | Timestamp`.
  * `pnpm run ci:tracked` and `pnpm run verify:workspace:tracked code-agent` both pass (15,775 tests); PR opened targeting `development`.
